description: This file defines helper functions for interacting with sensor endpoints, providing utilities to check faulted and bypassed states based on endpoint attributes and events in a device service context.

methods.name: isEndpointFaulted
methods.description: Checks if the given DSEndpoint indicates a faulted state based on its 'status' attribute.

methods.name: isEndpointFaultedViaEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event indicates the associated endpoint is faulted by inspecting the event's resource ID and state.

methods.name: isEndpointBypassed
methods.description: Checks if the given DSEndpoint indicates a bypassed state based on its 'bypassed' attribute.

methods.name: isEndpointBypassedViaEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event indicates the associated endpoint is bypassed by inspecting the event's resource ID and bypassed state.
